summary: Short kerb on a through road at a rail bridge, no parking.
reasons: Through road with no parked cars
Kerb meets bridge approach, no room
Blank wall and footpath, no pull-in

drivers.seclusion: Supermarket wall on one side and the rail cutting on the other, with no homes within 50 m; but the spot is in full view of a busy road.
drivers.access_and_room: Kerb runs straight into the bridge parapet; no shoulder or bay, so a van would stand in the lane.
drivers.traffic: Busy road feeding the bridge and the shopping centre.
drivers.convention: No cars parked on this kerb in Esri; the few cars parked in QLD are further up the west side.

flags: Noise: rail line and arterial traffic
sun_shade: Mostly open; the building shades the kerb in the morning.
